property_summary: For any arbitrary address caller, calling c.version() as an external call always returns a non-empty string in the reference; the mutant returns an empty string for some callers, so there exists a caller address for which the returned string is empty (violating the non-empty return rule).
change_summary: Return an empty string instead of "1.0.0".
mutated_unit_code: function version() external pure returns (string memory) { return ""; }
